## Checklist

- [ ] `./vendor/bin/pint --test` passes (formatting is clean)
- [ ] `php artisan test` passes (full suite green)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for any changed behavior
- [ ] Any schema change is a new migration; no committed migration was edited
- [ ] No new dependencies (or discussed and approved in a linked issue)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, one discrete change each
- [ ] All rendered user or payload data is escaped; no secrets are logged or hardcoded
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior or setup changed
